snippet.title: Casino Resort Tower – Nightlife Update Teaser
snippet.description:
The Nightlife Update is coming to Casino Resort Tower. The night begins.

Build a towering casino resort and watch it come alive. Crowds flow, elevators jam, and tiny decisions create big stories as your tower grows upward, floor by floor. Build it. Break it. Fix it.

Buy Now On Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1457030/Casino_Resort_Tower/

Casino Resort Tower Discord: https://discord.gg/2y5eXn3ubs

Twitter: https://twitter.com/CasinoRsrtTower
